description: React component for rendering an interactive mind map diagram with nodes, edges, layout calculations, zoom/pan controls, and custom node styling based on data-driven positions and types.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Extracts a percentage range from node data or title using heuristics.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a node is a step/milestone based on type or title.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates node levels in the graph based on edges and a center node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Determines the layout lane for a node based on its data and position.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds adjacency maps for source/target relationships from edges.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the right primary node based on levels.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions and connections for nodes in a design-matching layout with sub-branches.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps text labels into multiple lines with max characters per line and line count.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: React component rendering an interactive, zoomable, pannable mind map SVG with nodes, edges, and controls.
